title: Letter · Westfield Community Center
L: Thank you for volunteering to teach our free computer skills class for senior citizens this fall.
As we discussed, the class will meet every Wednesday from 10:00 A.M. to noon, starting September 10.
We expect about twelve participants, most of whom have never used e-mail.
The center will provide laptops for all participants, and a projector will be available in Room 3.
If you need any other materials, please let our program coordinator, Ms. Lopez, know by September 1 so that we can order them in time.
Many of our members have asked for a class like this for years.

w: To invite Mr. Haddad to join the center
